test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following figure is a combination of 4 CIRCLES, A, B, C and D. The numbers in the figure corresponds to the number of people in that category. Circle A represents people who like Science while circle B represents the ones who like History. Circle C and D represents people who like English and Sanskrit, respectively. According to the given figure, find total number of people who like ONLY Science AND ONLY English and History together?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcfc67012a56ada91d964b441f1dd2a36b49f206c6ae7c7cee7ac1dc0d294559.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51b03cc197f22f5a0b53385b8b9645750815c859505822e73f9851269946d360.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of people who like ONLY Science AND ONLY English and History together".

So, the total number of 'people who like ONLY Science AND ONLY English and History together' = 10 + 6 = 16.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
